EICMA 2026 • Benelli Showed the World Its New Tornado Naked Tre 903 Concept at EICMA 2026 and It's a Triple!
The 2027 Hopper 5 WL Is a Little Tin Box That Lacks for Nothing
15 photos
Photo: Modern Buggy RV
There is truth to that saying about strong essences being kept in small bottles, and the new travel trailer slash squaredrop from Modern Buggy RV wants to prove it to you. It's called the Hopper 5 WL and it's a stick-and-tin towable that hopes to check all the boxes you need.
Or, as Michigan-based manufacturer Modern Buggy, or ModBug for short, likes to say, "we don't want you to need anything more" than what you get with the Hopper 5 WL.
Introduced at the end of September 2026 as a 2027 unit, this is just one of the new addition to the Hopper series of lightweight and affordable towables from Modern Buggy. It's also part of the WL sub-series, where "WL" stands for "Woodline," a reference to the fact that this doesn't come with the all-fiberglass construction of the non-WL models.
Instead, it's a traditional stick-and-tin construction, and Modern Buggy is the first to emphasize that. That makes the Hopper 5 WL affordable – definitely more affordable than its fiberglass peers – while maintaining a reduced weight and still offering home-like comforts.
Photo: Modern Buggy RV Despite the number 5 in the name, the 5 WL is actually among the smaller entries in the Hopper series. Modern Buggy boasts that it can be towed even by smaller SUVs, which, together with its ability to sleep a family of four, should increase its appeal.
Long story short, it's a traditional aluminum-sided squaredrop that nonetheless goes the extra mile to cover all the basics and provide as much comfort as its footprint and budget will allow. It's an admirable attempt, and Modern Buggy makes sure they also deliver something extra in terms of looks and some autonomy.
Considering that they also promise proof that "you don't need a massive camper to make big memories," I'd say that these are all things that they must check if they want to be taken seriously. Which they obviously do .
Photo: Modern Buggy RV The Hopper 5 WL comes in at 16.5 feet (5 meters) of length and tips the scales at just 2,700 lbs (1,224 kg). It's designed primarily as a couple's RV, but it can offer accommodation overnight for as many as four people, even all of them adults, thanks to a combination of fixed bed and a convertible dinette.
Construction is with a custom steel chassis with a single axle specced for light offroading. That means a Dexter torsion suspension, beefy offroad tires, and 14 inches (35 cm) of ground clearance.
Being a stick-and-tin trailer means a wooden frame with aluminum sheeting, but Modern Buggy throws in an Azdel-backed single-piece fiberglass roof for good measure, a covered underbelly, and proper insulation to make this an extended seasonal camper.
Photo: Modern Buggy RV Again, they have to do all this, more or less, because they promise a towable with everything inside.
The layout is fairly common in the industry, with a booth dinette with a Lagun table that helps to convert the entire space into a bed, and a fixed east-to-west bed at the back. The galley kitchen is on the campside, to the left of the entrance, and the super compact wet bathroom is located right across from it.
Both these spaces are very cramped, which reduces their everyday functionality. The kitchen, for example, comes with a two-burner gas cooktop under a glass cover and a sink that takes up the remaining counter space, leaving zero space for meal prep.
Photo: Modern Buggy RV You also get storage under the counter and overhead, and a 12V fridge with freezer across the way. It's not much even for a mobile kitchen, and while it won't allow you to throw elaborate dinner parties, it will work just fine for a quick breakfast in two or four.
The bathroom is a cubicle with a plumbed toilet sat on an elevation of the shower tray, but you'd still have to sit down to use the included shower wand. Again, it's not much, but it is a functional, if cramped, bathroom inside a compact travel trailer.
Storage options are a bit more generous and suitable for a party of four. They include large compartments under the dinette benches and under the bed, but also in overhead cabinets throughout, finished in a nice White Latte color.
Photo: Modern Buggy RV Modern Buggy offers standard a 13,500-BTU roof-mounted AC unit, a Fogatti on-demand water heater, and a Suburban propane furnace, thus offering comfort regardless of temperatures outside. A marine-grade deep-cycle battery with disconnect is mentioned on the official page of the trailer, but its capacity isn't.
Also included is a composite entry step, an outside shower, hand-made valances with blackouts on all windows, self-adjusting electric brakes, and 16 gallons (60 liters) for freshwater and 32 gallons (121 liters) each for gray and black water.
The Hopper 5 WL comes prepped for flex solar, a power awning, and a tire carrier with a spare tire.
Photo: Modern Buggy RV Described as "perfect for those who crave adventure" but don't want to break the bank to pursue it or, on the contrary, compromise on personal comfort, the Hopper 5 WL is already out on dealer lots, with selling pricing starting at $20,000, depending on options.
From what I can tell, there are no extended video tours of this new floorplan online yet, so the brief walkthrough at this link will have to do.
